notes.title: New Patch S1.06 - Performance Fix
notes.content:
The patch to [b]version S1.06[/b] is now live! This patch fixes a performance issue observed on some PC systems. Affected systems were displaying very low framerates when the game was paused, idle, or in a menu for 35 to 75 seconds. The build ID for patch 1.06 on Steam is 15669028. 

We welcome any feedback or reports you'd like to share with us on this version in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1903910/discussions/]forums[/url], and we appreciate your support of Slave Zero X! 

Enjoy!

Poppy Works and Team Ziggurat

notes.title: Slave Zero X - Exclusive Discount, Trading Cards & More!
notes.content:
We’ve added Steam Trading Cards and more goodies to Slave Zero X, and we’re celebrating with a first-ever [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903910/Slave_Zero_X/]20% discount on Steam[/url] for a limited time!

Steam Trading Cards – how do they work? We’re glad you asked!

[list]
[*] Play Slave Zero X on Steam to get Steam Trading Cards in your Steam Inventory.
[*] Each trading card comes with a wallpaper-ready 1920x1080 version of its art.
[*] When you’ve collected a full set of Trading Cards, craft it into a Badge.
[*] Craft all five badges, and the foil badge, to work your way up the ranks of the SVK-DF – from the lowly Trooper to the godlike SovKhan. 
[*] To help complete sets of Trading Cards, individual cards and booster packs can be bought and sold in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/market/]Steam Community Market[/url].
[/list]

And it’s not just Steam Trading Cards – new Profile Backgrounds are also available, featuring art from Slave Zero X and concept art from the game’s development!
[list]
[*] Crafting Badges from Trading Cards gives a chance to unlock Profile Backgrounds.
[*] Profile Backgrounds can also be purchased from the Steam Points Shop with Steam Points.
[/list]

Last but not least, new Slave Zero X Steam Emoticons, featuring art and characters from the game, are also available!
[list]
[*] Some of these Emoticons were created during the game’s development for use by the development and publishing teams in their Discord and Slack channels.
[*] Crafting Badges from Trading Cards gives a chance to unlock Steam Emoticons.
[*] Steam Emoticons can also be purchased from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/c/emoticons]Steam Points Shop[/url] with Steam Points.
[/list]

The 20% discount on the game and its deluxe edition will last until August 30, 2024. The Trading Cards, Profile Backgrounds, and Emoticons will continue to be available after the end of the discount.

notes.title: New Slave Zero X Mod for Quake!
notes.content:
Brace yourselves for an adrenaline-pumping experience with Slave Zero X: Episode Enyo, an all-new, free Quake campaign set in the captivating world of Slave Zero. Play it now on PC, PlayStation, Switch or Xbox - found directly in Quake's downloadable content. 


🌐 Journey into the Past: Slave Zero X: Episode Enyo serves as a riveting prequel to the 1999 Dreamcast and PC cult classic Slave Zero. Dive into the immersive narrative that unfolds before the events of Slave Zero X, experiencing the intense story from the perspective of one of the game’s main antagonists, the elite assassin Enyo.


🚀 The Warpath Unveiled: Armed to the teeth and fueled by vengeance, Enyo embarks on a warpath to bring down her most formidable target yet: the Sovereign Khan. Prepare for heart-pounding action and strategic gameplay as you navigate through six gripping levels of relentless combat.


🎮 Features That Pack a Punch:
[list]
[*] 6 Campaign Levels: Immerse yourself in the rich storyline through six meticulously crafted levels.
[*] 1 Deathmatch Arena: Test your skills against friends or foes in a dynamic deathmatch arena.
[*] 8 New Weapons + 1 Secret Weapon: Arm yourself with an arsenal of new and powerful weapons, including a secret weapon for those who dare to uncover it.
[*] 13 New Enemies: Face off against a diverse range of enemies, each with unique challenges and combat styles.
[*] 1 New Powerup: Discover a game-changing powerup that adds a new layer of strategy to your gameplay.
[*] Original Soundtrack by Aleks Kmiec: Immerse yourself in the world of Episode Enyo with an original soundtrack crafted by the talented Aleks Kmiec.
[/list]

🔗 Dive Deeper: For an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the development process, check out the developer interview with Poppy Works and Ironwood Software at [url=https://slayersclub.bethesda.net/en-US]Slayers Club.[/url]


🎁 Play for Free: Experience the action-packed Episode Enyo for free directly inside Quake on PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation and Xbox platforms.


💾 Stand Alone Package: For those who prefer a standalone experience, a special package is available for download. Compatible with open-source versions of Quake like Ironwail, Quakespasm, vkQuake, and more, this standalone version offers flexibility and accessibility for all players.


🚀 Download Now and Conquer the Warpath [url=https://poppy.works/?games=slave-zero-x-episode-enyo]HERE[/url]

notes.title: Slave Zero X Gets A Release Date
notes.content:
Slave Zero X is launching on PC, PlayStation 4/5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch on February 21, 2024. Made in partnership with Poppy Works and the team behind the renowned Devil Engine, Slave Zero X is a stylish 2.5D character action game set in the biopunk world of Slave Zero (1999).

[previewyoutube=5UTiEsflcv8;full][/previewyoutube]

The newest title in the classic Dreamcast Slave Zero™ franchise will bring a whole new side-scrolling hack-and-slash experience to fans of the original game. A satisfyingly punishing game, Slave Zero™ X sees the protagonist, Shou, merging with a stolen Slave Unit Prototype, becoming a furious Devil in pursuit of killing a false God. Take up arms and do battle against the violent forces of the tyrannical SovKhan, the violent dictator who rules Megacity S1-9 with fists of iron and flesh. 

Featuring multiple gameplay modes and a variety of futuristic 2.5D dystopian urban levels to battle through, players will string together brutal combos and fight through waves of genetically enhanced biopunk opponents — all to the tune of a gnarly synth soundtrack. Run & slash your way through a dystopian future in this character action game which will resonate with fans of action and fighting game favorites Devil May Cry, Strider, and Guilty Gear.

[b]Key Features of Slave Zero™ X include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Different Modes to Mutilate: Play through the story, build your combo-crushing skills in training mode, or test your might in the post-story Bloody Palace mode
[*] Hack-n-Slash ‘n Slash ‘n Slash…: Chain together lethal attack combos with your sword and an array of explosive ordinance while leaping, sprinting, and flipping your way through a grim biopunk world
[*] A 2.5D Environment Worthy of H.R. Giger: Battle your way through massive levels and boss-rushes in a lo-fi blend of 2D and 3D art reminiscent of the 90s Dreamcast era.
[*] Brutal Battles and Cutthroat Stages: Conquer mini-bosses and climactic arch-villains in unforgettable combat sequences
[*] Blood-Soaked and Synth-Soaked: Immerse yourself in a world of heavy Drum ‘n Bass and industrial tracks that get more intense as the action heats up
[/list]
Slave Zero™ X is available to wishlist now on Steam, GOG, and PlayStation and you can play through the demo on Steam.
